basis: Author confirms filename codes are place names; no independent coordinate verification. df/zdf conservatively co-assigned without claiming verified equivalence.
group_selection: Exhaustive count-only normalized squared deviation from 70/20/10, seed42 tie order. No model results used.
limitation: Place-code separation is not proof of site-level independence or a geographic buffer. Source validation and test contain positives only; no negative-only-scene false-alarm assessment.
